# The Relationship Between U.S. Stock Market Returns and Treasury Bond Yields: A Statistical Analysis

I am comparing the 10 year bond and the stock market from 2000 to current day. My sources are yahoo financial for the Treasury Bond and the Federal Reserve Bank of St. Louis / FRED.

```{r}
#| label: Loaded Data
#| include: false
library(quantmod)
library(fredr)
library(tidyverse)
fredr_has_key()

getSymbols(
  "^GSPC",
  src= "yahoo",
  from = "2000-01-01",
  to = "2026-08-20"
)

sp500 <- data.frame(
  date = index(GSPC), 
  sp500 = as.numeric(Cl(GSPC))
)

treasury10 <- fredr(
  series_id = "DGS10",
  observation_start = as.Date("2000-01-01")
)|>
  select(date, value)|>
  rename(treasury10 = value)


stock_bond <- sp500|>
  inner_join(treasury10, by = "date")

range(sp500$date)
range(treasury10$date)
range(stock_bond$date)

```

```{r}
#| label: Change/Return
#| include: false
library(quantmod)
library(fredr)
library(tidyverse)

stock_bond <- stock_bond |>
  arrange(date) |>
  mutate(
    sp500_return = (sp500 / lag(sp500)) - 1,
    treasury10_change = treasury10 - lag(treasury10)
  )

head(stock_bond)
```

```{r}
#| label: CleanStockBond
#| include: false
library(quantmod)
library(fredr)
library(tidyverse)

stock_bond_clean <- stock_bond |>
  drop_na(sp500_return, treasury10_change)

summary(stock_bond_clean)
```

```{r}
#| label: SP500&10TGraph
#| echo: false
library(quantmod)
library(fredr)
library(tidyverse)

ggplot(stock_bond, aes(x = date, y = sp500)) +
  geom_line() + 
  labs(
    title = "S&P 500 Perfomance, 2000-2026",
    x = "Year",
    y = "S&P 500"
  )

ggplot(stock_bond, aes(x = date, y = treasury10)) +
  geom_line() + 
  labs(
    title = "10-Year U.S. Treasury Yield, 2000-2026",
    x = "Year",
    y = "10-Year Treasury Yield(%)"
  )
```

```{r}
#| label: Scatterplot
#| echo: false
library(quantmod)
library(fredr)
library(tidyverse)

ggplot(
  stock_bond_clean,
  aes(
    x = treasury10_change,
    y = sp500_return
  )
) + 
  geom_point(alpha = 0.25) + 
  geom_smooth(method = "lm") + 
  labs(
    title = "S&P 500 Returns vs. 10-Year Treasury Yield Changes",
    x = "Change in 10-Year Treasury Yield",
    y = "S&P 500 Daily Return"
  )
```

```{r}
#| label: Line Regression
library(quantmod)
library(fredr)
library(tidyverse)

model1 <- lm(
  sp500_return ~ treasury10_change, 
  data = stock_bond_clean
)

summary(model1)
```

A linear regression of daily S&P 500 returns on daily changes in the 10-year Treasury yield from 2000–2026 found a statistically significant positive association (β = 0.060, p \< 0.001). However, the model's R² of 0.083 indicates that Treasury yield changes alone explain only a small portion of daily equity-return variation.

## How did the relationship between U.S. stock-market returns and changes in 10-year Treasury yields differ between the 2008–2009 financial crisis and the 2020 COVID-19 market shock?

```{r}
#| label: FinancialC_dataDate
#| include: false
library(quantmod)
library(fredr)
library(tidyverse)

financial_crisis <- stock_bond_clean |>
  filter(
    date >= as.Date("2008-01-01"),
    date <= as.Date("2009-12-31")
  )

range(financial_crisis$date)
```

```{r}
#| label: covid_dataDate
#| include: false
covid <- stock_bond_clean |>
  filter(
    date >= as.Date("202-01-01"),
    date <= as.Date("2020-12-31")
  )

range(covid$date)
```

```{r}
#| label: financialc_model
#| echo: false
financial_model <- lm(
  sp500_return ~ treasury10_change,
  data = financial_crisis
)

summary(financial_crisis)
```

```{r}
#| label: covid_model
#| echo: false
covid_model <- lm(
  sp500_return ~ treasury10_change,
  data = covid
)

summary(covid_model)
```

```{r}
#| label: Correlation
#| include: false
financial_crisis_clean <- financial_crisis |>
  drop_na(sp500_return, treasury10_change)

cor(
  financial_crisis_clean$sp500_return,
  financial_crisis_clean$treasury10_change
)

covid_clean <- covid |>
  drop_na(sp500_return, treasury10_change)

cor(
  covid_clean$sp500_return,
  covid_clean$treasury10_change
)
```

```{r}
#| label: Comparison
#| include: false
comparison <- data.frame(
  Period = c(
    "2000–2026",
    "2008-2009 Financial Crisis",
    "2020 COVID-19"
  ),
  
  Correlation = c(
    cor(
      stock_bond_clean$sp500_return,
      stock_bond_clean$treasury10_change
    ),
    
    cor(
      financial_crisis_clean$sp500_return,
      financial_crisis_clean$treasury10_change
    ),
    
    cor(
      covid_clean$sp500_return,
      covid_clean$treasury10_change
    )
  ),
  
  Beta = c(
    coef(model1)["treasury10_change"],
    coef(financial_model)["treasury10_change"],
    coef(covid_model)["treasury10_change"]
  ),
  
  R_squared = c(
    summary(model1)$r.squared,
    summary(financial_model)$r.squared,
    summary(covid_model)$r.squared
  )
)

comparison
```

```{r}
#| label: FinC_graph
#| echo: false
ggplot(
  financial_crisis_clean,
  aes(
    x= treasury10_change,
    y=sp500_return
  )
) +
  geom_point(alpha = 0.4) + 
  geom_smooth(method = "lm")+
  labs(
    title = "S&P500 returns vs. Treasury Yiels Changes",
    subtitle = "2009-2009 Financial Crisis",
    x = "Change in 10-Year Treasury Yield",
    y = "S&P 500 Daily Return"
  )
```

```{r}
#| label: CovidGraph
#| echo: false
ggplot(
  covid_clean,
  aes(
    x=treasury10_change,
    y=sp500_return
  )
) +
  geom_point(alpha = 0.4) + 
  geom_smooth(method = "lm")+
  labs(
    title = "S&P500 returns vs. Treasury Yiels Changes",
    subtitle = "Covid-19 2020 Period",
    x = "Change in 10-Year Treasury Yield",
    y = "S&P 500 Daily Return"
  )
```

The relationship between stock-market returns and changes in 10-Year treasury yields appear to become stronger during periods of major financial stress. Judging R² we can see a that the 10-year bond increases in portion and relation to the S&P 500 daily return. As seen with R² of 0.0824 over the years 2000-2026 to a 0.1495 in the financial crisis and a 0.1405 during COVID.

```{r}
#| label: Crisis_stats
#| include: false
crisis_stats_long <- comparison |>
  pivot_longer(
    cols = c(Correlation, Beta, R_squared),
    names_to = "Statistics", 
    values_to = "Value"
  )|>
  mutate(
    Value = if_else(
      Statistics == "R_squared",
      Value * 100,
      Value
    )
  )

crisis_stats_long <- crisis_stats_long |>
  mutate(
    Statistics = recode(
      Statistics,
      "Correlation" = "Correlation",
      "Beta" = "Regression Beta",
      "R_squared" = "R² (%)"
    )
  )

crisis_stats_long
```

```{r}
#| label: Stats Bar
#| echo: false
ggplot(
  crisis_stats_long,
  aes(x = Period, y = Value)
) + 
  geom_col() + 
  facet_wrap(~ Statistics, scales = "free_y") + 
  labs(
    title = "Stock-Treasury Relationship During Major Crises",
    subtitle = "Comparison of correlation, regression coefficient, and R²",
    x = "Period/Crisis",
    y = "Value"
  ) + 
  theme(
    axis.text.x = element_text(angle = 45, hjust = 1)
  )
```
